data.desc: DeFi Technologies Inc. ( Nasdaq: DEFT ) ( CBOE CA: DEFI ) ( GR: R9B ) ( Brazil B3: DEFT31) is a regulated capital markets platform for digital assets. Its subsidiary Valour, is a leading issuer of digital asset investment products, with more than 100 exchange traded products on major global exchanges and, through Valour Funds SPC, a fund platform for professional investors. Its trading business, Stillman Digital, provides institutional execution, liquidity and settlement. The Company also operates research and index capabilities and holds a private investment portfolio.
